    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    x = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    edges = [tuple(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)]

    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for a, b in edges:
        adj[a].append(b)
        adj[b].append(a)

    def dfs(node, parent):
        nonlocal total_sum
        current_gcd = x[node - 1]
        for child in adj[node]:
            if child != parent:
                child_gcd = dfs(child, node)
                current_gcd = gcd(current_gcd, child_gcd)
        total_sum = (total_sum + current_gcd) % MOD
        return current_gcd

    total_sum = 0
    dfs(1, -1)
    print(total_sum)
